text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planned change window (midnight PT) this Thu. Requesting a quiet corridor from 23:30-02:30 PT. Please confirm canary owners, rollback owners, and pin list by EOD today. Link to release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/3.2.1 :wave:

josh: I can own canary + canary smoke. Will be online 23:15–01:00 PT.

olivia: I'll own rollback & emergency pin rollback ops. Add me to the ping rota.

maya: Thanks. Here's the warmup checklist I'm copying into the thread — keep it short and actionable:
```
- Pre-warm: start canary pool 30m before quiet window
- Smoke: run integration smoke + auth flows (3 reps)
- Traffic: route 2% traffic to canary for 20m then 5% for 10m
- Metrics: latency, 5xx, token-cost delta, embedding QPS
- Pin: pin user-facing model to v3.2.1 during window
- Rollback: 15-minute decision clock, automated unpin allowed
```

maya: Pin command for deploy-bot (we'll use this in ops):
`/deploy pin model:llm-redwood:v3.2.1 --scope=global --reason="launch freeze"`

deploy-bot: NOTE: Scheduled pin command queued by @maya. Use `/deploy status 6060708090` to see progress. :robot_face:

josh: Smoke test shell (quick paste) — run from ci-runner: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_KEY" \\n  -d '{"model":"llm-redwood:v3.2.1","input":"smoke test "}'
```

sam (oncall): Reminder — set alert thresholds lower for the window: latency +50ms, 5xx > 1% over baseline. I'll be monitoring.

olivia: For rollback owners: myself, @sam (oncall). If rollback needed, decision by Olivia or Sam, then execute: `deploy rollback model:llm-redwood --to-tag=v3.2.0` and unpin.

maya: Small note on rollforward policy: if canary looks stable but a downstream infra flake causes a revert, we may rollforward the model only after 60m cooling period and explicit thumbs-up in this channel.

josh: Can we enable auto-prefix-cache warmup for top 5 routes? I can push a config change 45m before window.

olivia: Yes please — that reduces cold-start error noise. josh, add exact route list here when possible.

deploy-bot: Canary pool started: pool-gpu-7. Instances: 4. Canary traffic live at 2%. (req id: cb-6060708090-1)

josh: Added routes: `/chat`, `/embed`, `/search` to warmup script. Pushing now.

maya: Final checklist before quiet corridor: 1) pin queued, 2) canary owners assigned, 3) rollback owners assigned, 4) smoke script validated, 5) alert thresholds lowered. If anyone sees blockers, call it out. Otherwise we'll proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:

olivia: All good from security/compliance side. I'm on-call for rollback.

sam (oncall): I will monitor metrics and be ready to flip the switch. Ping me at any sign >0.8% 5xx.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post a 30-minute reminder in this thread before 23:30 PT.
